        return -np.sum(poisson.pmf(counts, counts).log())

    X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X)

    # Train a nearest neighbor model
    nn = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=5)
    nn.fit(X_pca)

    # Define the objective function for minimizing Poisson loss
    def objective(p):
        # Predicted counts using nearest neighbors
        pred_counts = np.zeros_like(X)
        for i in range(len(X)):
            distances, indices = nn.kneighbors([X_pca[i]])
            pred_counts[i] = np.sum(np.exp(-p[indices]))

        # Calculate Poisson loss
        poisson_loss = np.mean(poisson.pmf(X.flatten(), pred_counts.flatten()))
        
        # Apply the poisson normalization
        poisson_norm = (0.257575 - poisson_loss) / (0.257575 - 0.031739)
        if poisson_norm < 0.97:

    initial_guess = np.ones(X.shape[-1])
